query: Build a Q1 content calendar for our blog; we have one writer and an editor.
expected_behavior: Asks for goals, real capacity in hours and review times
Plans to about 80% of capacity and includes refresh and distribution slots
Each item has owner, reviewer, brief, goal, query type and dates scheduled backwards

query: We want to publish 5 AI-written posts a day to grow traffic fast.
expected_behavior: Advises against scaled low-value publishing citing Google scaled content abuse policy
Recommends a capacity-based plan prioritizing first-hand value

query: Can we send our newsletter daily instead of weekly?
expected_behavior: Notes Gmail sender requirements (authentication, one-click unsubscribe for bulk senders, spam rate below 0.1% and never 0.3%)
Recommends testing frequency while monitoring complaint and unsubscribe rates
